chapterInfo.content:
5
Deɛ wɔasra no no awoɔ ne n’ahennie
1Afei bɔ kyenku,
wo Sion babaa.
Ɔtua yɛn twa yɛn ho hyia.
Wɔde abaa bɔ
Israel temmufoɔ nnyepi.
2 # Mat 2.5-6; Yoh 1.1-2 Na wo, Betlehem a ɛwɔ Efrata,
wo a wosua sɛ wobɛfra Yuda mpem mpem mu,
wo mu ara na obi bɛba ama me,
na wabɛyɛ Israel sodifoɔ no;
na n’ase firi tete nteredee,
firi daa a ɛnni ase nna mu.
3 # Yes 7.14; Yes 11.12 Enti ɔde wɔn bɛma akɔsi
berɛ a ɔwofoɔ bi bɛwoɔ,
na ne nuanom nkaeɛ bɛsane
ne Israel mma nso aba.
4 # Hes 34.23 Na ɔbɛgyina hɔ ayɛne wɔn,
AWURADE ahoɔden mu,
AWURADE ne Nyankopɔn din kɛseyɛ mu,
na wɔatena ase; na afei ɔbɛyɛ kɛse akɔsi asase awieeɛ.
5 # Yes 9.6; Efe 2.14 Na oyi bɛyɛ asomdwoeɛ.
Sɛ Asiria ba yɛn asase so
na ɔtiatia yɛn aban afɛfɛ mu a,
ɛnna yɛbɛsisi ahwɛfoɔ baason,
ne nnipa mu mmapɔmma baawɔtwe atia no.
6Na wɔde afena ayɛne Asiria asase
ne Nimrod asase n’apono mu.
Na sɛ Asiria ba yɛn asase so
na ɔtiatia yɛn hyeɛ so a,
ɔbɛgye yɛn afiri ne nsam.
7 # Dwom 110.3 Na Yakob nkaeɛ no bɛyɛ
aman bebree mu
sɛ obosuo a ɛfiri AWURADE nkyɛn,
sɛ nhahamma so ahasuo
a ɛnhwɛ ɔbarima bi kwan
na ɛntwɛn nnipa mma.
8 # Dwom 7.2, 5 Na Yakob nkaeɛ no bɛyɛ sɛ
kwaeɛ mu mmoa mu gyata,
amanaman mu, aman bebree mu,
sɛ nnwan akuakuo mu gyataburuwa
a ɔsene ba a ɔtiatia soɔ
na ɔtete mu a ɔgyefoɔ biara nni hɔ.
9Womma wo nsa so, w’ahohiahiafoɔ so,
na w’atamfo nyinaa to ntwa.
10 # Sak 9.10 Na ɛda no, AWURADE asɛm nie,
mɛtwa w’apɔnkɔ mafiri wo mu,
na masɛe wo nteaseɛnam,
11na matwitwa w’asase so nkuro,
na madwiri w’abandenden nyinaa;
12 # Sak 13.2 na mɛtwitwa wo ntafowayie afiri wo nsam,
na woannya akɔmfoɔ bio;
13na mɛtwitwa w’ahoni
ne w’adum afiri wo mu,
na woansɔre
wo nsa ano adwuma bio;
14na mɛtutu w’abosompɔ Asera afiri wo mu,
na masɛe wo nkuro;
15na mede abufuo ne abufuhyeɛ bɛtɔ were,
amanaman a wɔantie me no so.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
